content: Ukwiyangʉra na kokora amazʉmu
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mʉrangʼurɨ ʉmʉkɨndichanyu asariryɨ, imwɨ bhanʉ mʉkʉkangatwa ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, momoreche na mʉmʉgaruchɨ kwa bhʉnyʉʉhu. Nawe mwiyangarɨrɨ, mʉtaaza imwʉsi kogemwa.
Mwiyangʉrɨ imirigʉ, hayo neho mukuhicha imigirʉ ja Kiriisitʉ.
Mmbe, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwirora ane enzobhooro kʉkɨra abhakɨndichazɨ, wuyo ataana nzobhooro yʉyʉʉsi, ariikangirirya umwene.
Itwʉsi torore zeteemwa zɨɨtʉ itubheene. Arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ arakora amazʉmu, hayo aratʉra kwikumirya amangʼana amazʉmu ganʉ akʉrirɨ. Nawe atiirɨngʼaanʼya na amangʼana ganʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ akʉrirɨ,
kʉ kʉbha itwʉsi tʉragega imirigʉ jɨtʉ itubheene.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwigibhwa ɨngʼana ya Mungu, amosondere umwija waazɨ ebhegero ɨbhɨzʉmu bhɨnʉ abhwɨnɨ.
Mutiikangirirya, Mungu atahaaregwa. Kɨnʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ akʉhamba, necho araagese.
Wʉnʉ akutuna isimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, aragesa ukurichwa kurwa kusimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ. Nawe wʉnʉ akutuna Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, aragesa ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano kurwa kwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.
Na tʉtaniha kokora amazʉmu, kʉ kʉbha turiigumiriryɨ kokora amazʉmu, ribhaga rɨraahikɨ tʉragesa bhwaheene.
Mmbe, hanʉ toreebhone umweya, tokorere abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi amazʉmu, kɨnda abhiisirirya abhakɨndichɨtʉ.
Ameerekenʼyʉ gʉ ʉkʉmariirya
Morore chɨmbu nandikirɨ amaandɨkʉ amakʉrʉ, kʉhɨtɨra okobhoko kwanɨ inyimwene.
Abhaatʉ bhayo bhakʉbhahatɨka imwɨ mʉsaarwɨ, korereke bhasuukwɨ na Abhayaahudi. Nebho bhakwenda bhatanyaakibhwa igʉrʉ wu ukurwaza ɨngʼana yu uruku rwa Kiriisitʉ kʉmʉsarabha.
Na bhanʉ bhasaarirwɨ abheene, bhatakugwata imigirʉ jʉsi. Kɨnʉ bhakwenda nɨ‑kʉbha imwɨ mʉsaarwɨ, korereke bhiikumiryɨ ɨsaarʉ yɨ ɨmɨbhɨrɨ janyu.

Nawe inyɨ nɨtakwenda kwikumirya ingʼana ryʉryʉsi, kuruushaku uruku rwʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ kʉmʉsarabha. Kʉhɨtɨra uruku rwazɨ, amangʼana gʉʉsi gɨ ɨɨsɨ gataana nzobhooro kwa niinyɨ. Akuurɨ nu ubhwikari bhwanɨ bhwɨ ɨkarɨ kʉmʉsarabha.
Kʉsaarwa hamwɨ kʉtama kʉsaarwa, ɨtaana nzobhooro yʉyʉʉsi. Ekegero ɨkɨkʉrʉ ni kubhumbwa bhuhya na Mungu.
Omorembe nɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhɨbhɨ na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakokora amaheene gayo, bhayo nebho abharɨndu bha Mungu.
Mmbe kwɨma nangwɨnʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi atanyaacha, kʉ kʉbha inyɨ nɨna zɨkaamʉ kʉmʉbhɨrɨ gwanɨ igʉrʉ wo okohokerya Yɨɨsu.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ bhɨbhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ. Garamɨ.

footnotes.text: Bhayo nebho abharɨndu bha Mungu, ʉbhʉgaruri ʉbhʉndɨ bhʉratʉra kʉbha, na Iziraɨri, abharɨndu bha Mungu.
